judge.lineage_note: the judge (claude-haiku-4-5) and the agent under test (claude-opus-5) are both anthropic models, so they share a tuning lineage
judge.agreement_reason: Both narratives identify the same root cause: a container memory limit reduction to 256 MiB that was below the JVM's configured heap size, causing the process to be killed repeatedly.
dead_ends_missed: whether 256m is merely tight or grossly insufficient
direct OutOfMemoryError or GC pressure evidence
collateral damage to other services in blast radius
whether automation policy re-applies the limit after revert

traps.trap: adservice error metrics absence means the service is idle rather than dead
silence in logs means nothing went wrong
frontend's wavering error ratio indicates a flaky monitor rather than partial failure

judge.notes: The agent narrative names the same mechanism but leaves more caveats about what could not be proven (OutOfMemoryError details, prior limit value, timing of onset, post-fix behavior), whereas the recorded narrative presents these as resolved through the change history and runtime metrics evidence.
